name: Sutherland (United Kingdom)
description: A white field bearing a black eight-armed star-cross — a cross and saltire radiating from the centre — charged with a golden six-pointed star.
history: Registered with the Flag Institute in 2018 after a county-wide vote.

features.role: combined cross and saltire radiating to the edges

features.symbolism: from the arms of the earls of Sutherland
